cover_headline: Anil Menon Completes NASA's 100th US Spacewalk, Installing Seventh ISS Solar Array
facts: Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk completed a 7-hour, 11-minute spacewalk on October 29, installing the seventh roll-out solar array
The excursion was the 100th US spacewalk conducted from the station's Quest airlock and the 285th spacewalk in support of the ISS overall
Once the eighth and final array is installed on November 5, the upgrade will raise the station's available power by up to 30 percent, from about 160 to roughly 215 kilowatts

end.headline: Anil Menon Completes NASA's 100th US Spacewalk, Installing Seventh ISS Solar Array
end.line: NASA astronaut Anil Menon and Canada's Joshua Kutryk spent 7 hours 11 minutes outside the International Space Station on October 29, deploying the seventh roll-out solar array in the station's power upgrade.
